catalog.name: Windows PC
catalog.description: Let the agent work on your Windows computer — PowerShell, your files, your apps, its screen.
catalog.hint: The name is how you and the agent refer to this computer ("check the logs on my-laptop"). After adding it, click Connect and run the one-liner on that machine.

steps: Add the computer here, then click Connect on its card to get a one-time command.
Run that command in PowerShell on the computer you want to connect — it installs a small agent that dials this sandbox.
Nothing is opened on your network: the connection is outbound, so no port forwarding and no VPN.
You can revoke it any time from this card; `intentic-host uninstall` removes the agent from the machine.

catalog.name: Linux PC
catalog.description: Let the agent work on your Linux computer — your shell, your files, your desktop session.
catalog.hint: The name is how you and the agent refer to this computer ("run the tests on my-desktop"). After adding it, click Connect and run the one-liner on that machine.

steps: Add the computer here, then click Connect on its card to get a one-time command.
Run that command in a terminal on the computer you want to connect — it installs a small agent that dials this sandbox.
Nothing is opened on your network: the connection is outbound, so no port forwarding and no VPN.
You can revoke it any time from this card; `intentic-host uninstall` removes the agent from the machine.
